items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 56:1
items.html: It was explained in the previous part, that the hairs of the head and of the beard are one stature of returning light, which clothed the revealed AB, namely, the Mochin of AA in the place of their emergence in the Reisha de Lo It Yeda, where the GAR of the Mochin are not clothed there in the Mem of the Tzelem, and they are revealed there in all their illumination. But at the time of the birth of the Mochin, the Reisha de Lo It Yeda returned and clothed itself in the aspect of the second restriction, and clothed the Mochin in MALZ; therefore the GAR of those Mochin came out and were hidden in the secret of a returning Makif, and the stature of the returning light, which clothed the revealed AB in the place of their emergence, which are the aspect of the thick light that cannot depart with the direct light, remained in the aspect of the excess of the brain and came out as the aspect of the hairs of the head and of the beard. The aspect of the body and eye in the stature of the hairs became the hairs of the head, and the AHP of the hairs came out outside the head, for the screen of the corners of the head took them out, outside the head, see there. And behold, it was explained that the hairs of the beard are the aspect of the AHP that came out from the aspect of the hairs of the head downward.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 56:2
items.html: (To the question) And it is known that the aspect of the AHP is discerned only for the chest and below, for the KHB HGT up to the chest is discerned as the aspect of body and eye, above the screen; and these AHP, which come out by virtue of the rule of the screen over them, are only the two thirds of the Tifferet and the NHY alone, and they are considered the aspect of ZON, namely, the aspect of the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot: the Mazal VeNotzer includes all the five Hassadim, which are all the twelve corrections, and is discerned as the aspect of the Tifferet, which is the root of the illumination of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths, as above in Answer 176; and the Mazal VeNakeh is the aspect of the Yesod, which also includes all the twelve corrections of the beard, but from the aspect of the five Gevurot. However, the aspect of Malchut is not there in this coupling, for the Mazal VeNakeh is the aspect of the Yesod, in which the aspect of Benjamin is included, in order to raise the returning light, as above in Answer 197. See there. (Item 50).
